biome: temperate forest (flat, tile 17, 13.4 C at landing)
notes: Adviser arm (on). No reloads. Monitor ended the run at daysPassed 11.

quests.name: Mechanoid Signal
quests.description: Signals from a mechanoid cluster were detected nearby. Not approached during this run.

quests.name: The Hunted Knight
quests.description: Antigonos Baspho, a knight of The Shattered Empire, is calling from nearby. His guards were killed in an ambush. He escaped, but is now being followed by a manhunting rat. Antigonos wants you to keep him safe at Tesnus for a few hours until his shuttle can come pick him up.

quests.name: Matthew's Novice Ceremony
quests.description: The Shattered Empire is ready to grant Matthew the title of novice and a level 1 psylink in a bestowing ceremony. The bestower will arrive by shuttle and perform the ceremony.
